p: judgment: He has so sore afflicted me that men cannot judge my uprightness; for they judge only by outward signs.
My lips shall not speak wickedness: However men judge me, yet will I not speak contrary to that which I have said, and so do wickedly in betraying the truth.
justify you: Which condemns me as a wicked man, because the hand of God is on me.
integrity from me: I will not confess that God does thus punish me for my sins.
hope of the hypocrite: What advantage has the dissembler to gain, seeing he will lose his own soul?
God: That is, what God reserves for himself, and of which he gives not knowledge to all.
have seen it: That is, these secret judgments of God and yet do not understand them.
vain: Why do you then maintain this error?
portion of a wicked man with: Thus will God order the wicked, and punish him even to his posterity.
shall not weep: No one will lament him.
moth: Which breeds in another man's possessions or garment, but is soon shaken out.
he shall not be gathered: He means that the wicked tyrants will not have a quiet death, nor be buried honourably.
